description: On the green-covered table in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case with a short charging cable plugged into it. The right hand reaches in and grips the AirPods case as a right-hand object while the left hand pinches the cable near the connector as a left-hand object, then pulls the connector straight out to unplug it; the left hand lifts the loose cable end briefly and sets it back down while the right hand keeps holding the case.
